wall_thickness_differential.why: a grey rectangle and a smaller red rectangle with a dashed border, with dimension lines indicating a total width of 25mm and a reduced width of 22mm
wall_thickness_differential.subject: A close-up cross-section of the steel wall showing a 25mm block shrinking to 22mm as an 'acid' layer eats into the interior surface.
wall_thickness_differential.title: Corrosion Allowance Deficit

stress_concentration_heatmap.why: A schematic nozzle outline with horizontal red lines curving and bunching into sharp inner corners, overlaid with glowing heat-map spots.
stress_concentration_heatmap.subject: A heat-map overlay on a nozzle weld showing stress lines bunching and turning bright red at the sharp interior corners.
stress_concentration_heatmap.title: Nozzle Stress Concentration

comparison_diagram.why: one continuous horizontal red bar on the left and two shorter horizontal yellow bars separated by a gap on the right
comparison_diagram.subject: Side-by-side animation comparing the single rod design versus the two-rod modification.
comparison_diagram.title: Modification Comparison

thermal_gradient_map.why: на кадре видно «a single flat reddish-orange rectangle outlined in white, a dashed yellow line underneath it, and text labels above and below»; не хватает: The drawing consists of a single flat-colored block without any color gradient shifting from blue to red, heat radiation arrows, or distinct layers representing the steam jacket and steel wall.
thermal_gradient_map.subject: A cross-section showing heat radiating from the steam jacket into the steel wall, with a color gradient shifting from blue (cold) to red (hot).
thermal_gradient_map.title: Heating the Reactor Shell

vessel_cross_section.why: a vessel outline containing a dark filled region for liquid level, small yellow dots inside, an inlet pipe at the bottom, and a 20 FT height dimension line
vessel_cross_section.subject: the diagram is named "vessel cross section" — the drawing must show exactly that

thermal_gradient_cross_section.why: на кадре видно «a horizontal rectangle divided into a flat reddish section containing a yellow dot and a flat dark gray section, with a text label 'Yield Strength: 50 MPa' and an L-shaped line beneath.»; не хватает: The drawing shows flat solid colors and a yield strength label, missing any thermal color gradient, temperature values, or cross-sectional layer details.
thermal_gradient_cross_section.subject: the diagram is named "thermal gradient cross section" — the drawing must show exactly that
